raw_segments.text: Burgundy, pardon the frankness of my mirth, if I answer you for that.
If you would conjure in her, you must make a circle.
If conjure up love in her in his true likeness, he must appear naked and blind.
Can you blame her then, being a maid yet rozzed over with the virgin crimson of modesty, if
she deny the appearance of a naked blind boy in her naked seeing self?
It were, my lord, a hard condition for a maid to consign to.
